FINAL IVX IA + AUTONOMOUS PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
COMPLETE END TO END NOW — NO NEW FEATURES

PRIORITY: P0
MODE: DEPLOY, ACTIVATE, VERIFY, RECOVER, PROVE

Stop all unrelated feature development.

The immediate objective is to synchronize the latest owner GitHub code with
the real Render service backing api.ivxholding.com, activate IVX Autonomous
as a persistent production service, and verify the complete system live.

Do not use the unrelated static Render service.
Do not deploy an old commit.
Do not create a new app or repository.
Do not return another planning report.

==================================================
1. CONFIRM THE REAL PRODUCTION SERVICE
==================================================

Use the Render service currently mapped to:

https://api.ivxholding.com

Expected service previously identified:

ivx-holdings-platform

Confirm from Render:

SERVICE NAME:
SERVICE ID:
SERVICE TYPE:
CUSTOM DOMAIN:
REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
AUTO-DEPLOY STATUS:
BUILD COMMAND:
START COMMAND:
HEALTH ROUTE:
PORT:
CURRENT DEPLOYMENT ID:
CURRENT RUNTIME SHA:

Do not use:

rork-global-real-estate-invest1.onrender.com

unless Render proves that it is the service backing api.ivxholding.com.

==================================================
2. IDENTIFY THE EXACT RELEASE COMMIT
==================================================

Read the current owner repository:

ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest

Branch:

main

Return:

GITHUB HEAD FULL SHA:
COMMIT DATE:
COMMIT MESSAGE:
FILES CHANGED SINCE 905ebdc9:
VERIFYING TIMEOUT PRESENT:
AUTONOMOUS WORKER CHANGES PRESENT:
CHAT ORDERING CHANGES PRESENT:
AUTH CHANGES PRESENT:

Use the newest approved commit on main.

Do not deploy:

- edf62a9
- 905ebdc9
- any older preselected Render commit

unless it is proven to be the current GitHub HEAD.

==================================================
3. FIX THE RENDER DEPLOYMENT PIPELINE
==================================================

Inspect why production remained on 905ebdc9.

Check:

- auto-deploy enabled/disabled
- wrong repository binding
- wrong branch
- stale deploy hook
- failed build
- cancelled deploy
- missing environment variable
- build command failure
- start command failure
- health-check failure
- port binding
- database startup failure
- worker crash
- Render service paused/suspended

Return the exact root cause and build log.

If auto-deploy is broken:

1. Regenerate the deploy hook.
2. Bind it only to the correct production service.
3. Confirm repository and branch.
4. Trigger deployment of the current main HEAD.
5. Wait for terminal status.

Allowed terminal results:

LIVE
FAILED
CANCELLED

Do not stop at QUEUED, BUILDING, or IN_PROGRESS.

==================================================
4. DEPLOY THE LATEST COMMIT
==================================================

Owner authorization:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY

Deploy only the current approved GitHub HEAD.

Return:

PREVIOUS RUNTIME SHA:
TARGET GITHUB SHA:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
DEPLOY START:
BUILD STATUS:
BUILD LOG:
STARTUP STATUS:
STARTUP LOG:
DEPLOY FINISH:
FINAL STATUS:

==================================================
5. VERIFY PRODUCTION SHA PARITY
==================================================

Call live:

https://api.ivxholding.com/health
https://api.ivxholding.com/version

Required:

GITHUB HEAD === RENDER RUNTIME SHA
/health === HTTP 200
/version === TARGET SHA

Return:

GITHUB SHA:
RENDER SHA:
HEALTH SHA:
VERSION SHA:
ALL MATCH:
BOOT TIME:
SERVER VERSION:
DATABASE STATUS:
SUPABASE STATUS:

If any SHA differs, deployment is incomplete.

==================================================
6. ACTIVATE THE PERSISTENT AUTONOMOUS WORKER
==================================================

Deploy a real persistent worker or background service.

It must continue running after the Rork browser is closed.

Required:

- database-backed durable queue
- worker process
- scheduler
- heartbeat
- lease
- checkpoint
- idempotency key
- retry policy
- cancellation
- dead-letter queue
- restart recovery
- duplicate-worker prevention
- duplicate-commit prevention
- duplicate-deployment prevention

Return:

WORKER SERVICE:
WORKER DEPLOYMENT ID:
WORKER STATUS:
QUEUE:
SCHEDULER:
HEARTBEAT:
LAST HEARTBEAT:
ACTIVE TASKS:
RETRY QUEUE:
DEAD LETTER QUEUE:
NEXT SCHEDULED RUN:

Do not call Autonomous ACTIVE if no persistent process is running.

==================================================
7. VERIFYING TIMEOUT LIVE TEST
==================================================

The previously coded VERIFYING-timeout fix must now be proven live.

Create a controlled task that intentionally hangs during verification.

Prove:

- enters VERIFYING
- records stage start
- heartbeat is monitored
- timeout occurs
- task does not remain at 90%
- state becomes TIMED_OUT or approved failure state
- retry occurs correctly
- retry limit is enforced
- checkpoint is preserved
- owner receives exact failure message
- no duplicate commit/deploy occurs

Return:

TASK ID:
VERIFYING START:
TIMEOUT CONFIGURATION:
TIMEOUT AT:
FINAL STATE:
RETRY COUNT:
CHECKPOINT:
TRACE ID:
OWNER REPORT:

Also execute one normal successful task to prove the timeout does not cancel
valid work.

==================================================
8. AUTONOMOUS 24/7 ACTIVATION TEST
==================================================

Prove:

1. Queue survives worker restart.
2. Worker resumes interrupted task.
3. Heartbeat updates.
4. Duplicate worker is blocked.
5. Scheduler creates a task automatically.
6. QA-only task runs without code changes.
7. Code task stops at owner approval.
8. Unauthorized deployment is rejected.
9. Approved deployment succeeds.
10. Runtime SHA is verified.
11. Two-hour report is generated.
12. Dashboard shows the complete task.
13. Owner can cancel a task.
14. Failed task reaches retry/dead-letter correctly.
15. Worker continues after Rork closes.

==================================================
9. IVX IA CHAT INTEGRATION
==================================================

Connect the production autonomous runtime to IVX IA Chat.

Required chat messages:

- task created
- task started
- current stage
- approval required
- timeout
- retry
- deployment started
- deployment completed
- verification result
- blocker
- two-hour checkpoint
- daily report

Fix deterministic message order using:

server_created_at ASC
stable_message_id ASC

Required:

- no duplicates
- latest messages visible
- pagination correct
- realtime correct
- restart persistence
- optimistic messages reconciled

==================================================
10. OWNER APPROVAL GATES
==================================================

Verify live enforcement for:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY
CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATION
CONFIRM_IVX_ROLLBACK
CONFIRM_IVX_DESTRUCTIVE_ACTION

Approval must be:

- task scoped
- action scoped
- expiring
- non-replayable
- audited

Unauthorized attempts must return 403.

==================================================
11. RELEASE MANIFEST
==================================================

Create one canonical production release manifest:

REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
GITHUB SHA:
RENDER SERVICE:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
RUNTIME SHA:
WORKER SERVICE:
WORKER DEPLOYMENT:
DATABASE MIGRATION VERSION:
API VERSION:
APK VERSION:
APK VERSION CODE:
APK SHA-256:
PUBLIC APK URL:
LANDING VERSION:
ROLLBACK SHA:
DEPLOYED AT:
OWNER APPROVAL:

Store it in the proof ledger.

==================================================
12. CURRENT APK AND LANDING PARITY
==================================================

Verify:

- landing Download button serves current APK
- current APK version is correct
- versionCode is correct
- SHA-256 matches manifest
- APK contains approved API URL
- APK contains approved Supabase project
- no stale v1.4.36 link
- no stale CDN object

If mobile code changed, rebuild the APK.

Return:

APK URL:
HTTP STATUS:
CONTENT TYPE:
VERSION:
VERSION CODE:
EMBEDDED SHA:
SHA-256:
CLOUDFRONT STATUS:

==================================================
13. AUTHENTICATION SMOKE TEST AFTER DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After production synchronization, run fresh live tests:

OWNER:
- correct login
- wrong password
- logout/login
- session restore
- owner routes

MEMBER:
- registration
- login
- wrong password
- correct dashboard
- owner route denied

ROLE SMOKE TESTS:
- investor
- buyer
- JV
- tokenized
- broker
- agent
- land owner

Do not reuse old test results from an older runtime SHA.

==================================================
14. EMAIL STATUS
==================================================

Report truthfully:

SES/SMTP:
CONFIGURED / NOT_CONFIGURED

If not configured, deployment may still complete, but authentication cannot
receive final VERIFIED status.

Return exact missing configuration without exposing secrets.

==================================================
15. INDEPENDENT VERIFIER
==================================================

A separate verifier must independently retrieve:

- GitHub HEAD
- Render deployment
- runtime SHA
- worker heartbeat
- queue state
- live health
- live version
- autonomous timeout proof
- chat ordering proof
- APK metadata
- authentication smoke tests

The builder cannot approve its own work.

==================================================

==================================================
STRICT COMPLETION RULE
==================================================

Do not return FULLY_DEPLOYED_AND_LIVE_VERIFIED unless:

- correct production Render service is identified;
- newest approved GitHub HEAD is deployed;
- GitHub SHA equals runtime SHA;
- /health and /version show the same SHA;
- persistent autonomous worker is online;
- heartbeat and scheduler are active;
- restart recovery works;
- VERIFYING timeout works live;
- chat receives autonomous events in correct order;
- approval gates block unauthorized production actions;
- release manifest is complete;
- APK/landing parity is verified;
- fresh authentication smoke tests pass;
- independent verifier confirms the evidence.

Do not ask what to do next.
Execute this deployment sequence and return the evidence.
